title: Beta launch checklist - Nov 2
text:
Owner: **Wop testwell** · Launch date: <mention-date start="2026-11-02"/> at Westbrook University
## Product
- [x] Matching service v0.3 on staging (Daniel)
- [ ] API response time under 1 second with 200+ students (Daniel)
- [ ] Fix oversized groups for single-course students (Daniel)
- [ ] Database migration on <mention-date start="2026-10-17"/>, 11 PM - 1 AM ET (Daniel)
- [ ] Fix push notifications on Android 15 (Sam)
- [ ] New 4-screen onboarding in the app (Sam + Priya)
- [x] Final app icon and brand colors (Priya)
## App stores
- [ ] Android build submitted to Google Play by <mention-date start="2026-10-25"/> (Sam)
- [ ] iOS build submitted to the App Store by <mention-date start="2026-10-25"/> (Sam)
- [ ] Store screenshots and description (Priya + Wop)
## Beta testers
- [ ] Beta sign-up form live on the website (Wop)
- [ ] Migration notice sent to Westbrook beta testers on Friday (Wop)
- [ ] Launch day email to all beta testers (Wop)
- [ ] Tomas shares the launch in the Westbrook campus group chat
## Risks
- Android 15 push notification bug could delay the launch if the fix takes more than a week
- App store review can take up to 5 days
